channel.provenance_note: The official Stream 1 page explicitly publishes this permanent CRA HLS master for external players and third-party embedding. On 2026-10-22 TLS-verified master, media playlist and MPEG-TS sample requests passed with CORS enabled; the live media sequence advanced and a fresh HLS.js browser player decoded 720x405 video without player errors. Availability remains sitting-only, not always-on.

accessibility.notes: The official accessibility statement says some site recordings lack captions or an audio alternative; the sign-language page describes separate information videos. Neither establishes accessibility of the live chamber feed. Live captions, sign-language interpretation, and audio description remain unknown. Evidence reviewed 2026-10-01: https://www.psp.cz/sqw/hp.sqw?k=32 and https://www.psp.cz/informace-v-ceskem-znakovem-jazyce .

permission.summary: The official Stream 1 page explicitly publishes the raw HLS URL for external applications and alternative online players and supplies iframe HTML for embedding on other websites. This supports documented live playback and embedding; it does not establish broader recording, modification, or redistribution rights.
permission.recommendation: Use the documented HTTPS stream or iframe with clear Chamber attribution and an official source link after playback validation. Review separate terms before recording, modifying, or redistributing proceedings; the website disclaimer retains Office ownership and restricts bulk automated document copying.
